Print a fitted latent mixture model

print.latentmix.Rd

Shows the model header (model type, classes, starts, warnings), fit statistics, class sizes (by wave for an LTA, by group for a multigroup model) and the main parameter block: item-response probabilities, profile means and variances, growth-factor means and (co)variances, transition matrices, and the latent class regression when the model has covariates. summary() adds every parameter with robust standard errors.

Usage

# S3 method for class 'latentmix'
print(x, digits = 3, ...)

Arguments

x

A latentmix model.

digits

Number of decimal places.

...

Ignored.

Value

x, invisibly.

Details

Output uses UTF-8 box-drawing characters for rules. Parameter blocks are computed in Julia; if the model's Julia session has ended (see lm_end()) only the stored fit statistics and class sizes are printed.

See also

summary.latentmix(), lm_table()

Examples

data(aces)
# \donttest{
# print a 4-class ACE model with two decimals
m <- lca(aces, starts_with("ace_"), K = 4)     # 4 ACE classes, as generated
#> Starting Julia ...
print(m, digits = 2)
